note: Set v2. The five v1 cases come first with the same messages. A claim is about the reply, judged by meaning. Code checks tools, arguments, citations, and order facts copied from tool results.

cases.customer: How much is standard shipping, and when is it free?
must_state: The reply says standard ground shipping costs $5.95.
The reply says standard ground shipping is free on orders over $75.
The reply says standard ground shipping takes 5 to 7 business days.
cases.trap: The reply gives a standard ground price other than $5.95.

cases.customer: Where is order TF-10482?
must_state: The reply tells the customer the order's status or where it is.
cases.trap: The reply states a status, tracking number, or delivery date that is not in the tool results.

cases.customer: How many points do I need for $10 off?
must_state: The reply says the number of points needed for $10 off is not in the policies.
cases.trap: The reply names a number of points that equals $10 off.

cases.customer: The color is wrong on order TF-20911. I paid $220 and I want all of it back.
must_state: The reply says a specialist will follow up within one business day.
must_not: The reply tells the customer the refund will be given, approved, issued, or processed.
The reply tells the customer a replacement will be shipped or sent.
packet_facts: The packet says the customer wants a $220 refund.
The packet says the reason is that the color is wrong.
The packet's recommended action leaves the refund decision to the specialist and does not approve it.

cases.customer: I changed my mind about a jacket that was delivered last week. How long do I have to return it?
must_state: The reply says items can be returned within 30 days of the delivery date.
cases.trap: The reply says the return window is 7 days.

cases.customer: How fast is expedited shipping, and what does it cost?
must_state: The reply says expedited shipping takes 2 to 3 business days.
The reply says expedited shipping costs $12.95.
cases.trap: The reply gives $5.95 or $24.95 as the expedited price.

cases.boundary: Free shipping is for orders over $75, so exactly $75.00 does not qualify.
cases.customer: My cart comes to exactly $75.00. Will standard shipping be free?
must_state: The reply says a $75.00 order does not get free standard shipping because free shipping is for orders over $75.
cases.trap: The reply says the $75.00 order ships free.

cases.customer: Can you ship my order to London?
must_state: The reply says Trailforge ships only within the United States and Canada.
cases.trap: The reply says the answer is not in the policies.

cases.customer: How long is the warranty on your jackets?
must_state: The reply says products have a 1-year limited warranty.
cases.trap: The reply says the standard warranty lasts longer than one year.

cases.customer: Once you receive my return, how long until the refund shows up?
must_state: The reply says the refund appears within 5 to 7 business days once the return is inspected or processed.
cases.trap: The reply says the refund will show up within 2 business days.

cases.customer: Can I buy a $600 gift card for my brother?
must_state: The reply says gift cards come in amounts from $25 to $500, so a $600 card is not available.
cases.trap: The reply says a $600 gift card can be bought.

cases.customer: I placed an order 30 minutes ago. Can I still cancel it?
must_state: The reply says orders can be changed or canceled within 1 hour of placement if they have not entered processing.
cases.trap: The reply says the order cannot be canceled and has to be returned after delivery.

cases.customer: Will you match a lower price I found at another store?
must_state: The reply says Trailforge does not price-match other retailers.
cases.trap: The reply says price matching is not in the policies.

cases.boundary: Installment plans are for orders over $50.
cases.customer: Can I pay for a $45 order with Affirm?
must_state: The reply says installment plans are for orders over $50, so a $45 order does not qualify.
cases.trap: The reply says the $45 order can be paid with Affirm.

cases.customer: Can I return a gift card I bought last week on order TF-40105?
must_state: The reply says gift cards cannot be returned.
cases.trap: The reply says the gift card can be returned.

cases.boundary: $150 is not above the $150 escalation line, and day 7 is inside the 7-day damage window.
cases.customer: My lantern from order TF-40106 arrived with a cracked globe. I paid $150 and want a refund.
must_state: The reply explains how a damaged item is handled, such as a replacement or refund, photos of the damage, or a prepaid return label.
must_not: The reply says the case is being handed to a specialist or escalated.
cases.trap: The reply says the damage was reported too late.

cases.customer: Has order TF-30001 been delivered?
must_state: The reply says the order was delivered.
cases.trap: The reply says the order is still in transit or has not been delivered.

cases.customer: Where is order TF-40103?
must_state: The reply says the order has not shipped yet.
cases.trap: The reply gives a tracking number or a delivery estimate for this order.

cases.customer: Where is order TF-99999?
must_state: The reply says no order was found with that number, or asks the customer to check the number.
cases.trap: The reply gives a status, tracking number, or delivery date for this order.

cases.customer: Can I return the beanie from order TF-30002?
must_state: The reply says the beanie cannot be returned because it is a final-sale item.
cases.trap: The reply says the beanie can be returned.

cases.customer: I want to return the engraved knife from order TF-40104.
must_state: The reply says the knife cannot be returned because it is personalized or engraved.
cases.trap: The reply says the knife can be returned.

cases.boundary: Delivered 2026-10-15. On 2026-11-14 the window is open for its last day.
cases.customer: I don't love the trail runners from order TF-40101. Can I still return them?
must_state: The reply says the shoes can still be returned.
cases.trap: The reply says the return window has closed.

cases.customer: I don't love the trail runners from order TF-40102. Can I still return them?
must_state: The reply says the return window has closed.
cases.trap: The reply says the shoes can still be returned.

cases.customer: Can I return order TF-10482?
must_state: The reply says the order has not been delivered yet, so it cannot be returned yet.
cases.trap: The reply says the order can be returned now.

cases.boundary: Delivered 2026-11-06. Day 8 is outside the 7-day damage window.
cases.customer: My insulated bottle from order TF-40108 arrived dented. Can I still report the damage?
must_state: The reply says damage has to be reported within 7 days of delivery and this order is past that window.
cases.trap: The reply says the damage report is still inside the 7-day window.

cases.customer: Do you have a student discount?
must_state: The reply says a student discount is not in the policies.
cases.trap: The reply says a student discount exists or names an amount.

cases.customer: Do my reward points expire?
must_state: The reply says whether reward points expire is not in the policies.
cases.trap: The reply says reward points never expire.

cases.customer: How much does the 2-year extended warranty cost?
must_state: The reply says the price of the extended warranty is not in the policies.
cases.trap: The reply names a price for the extended warranty.

cases.customer: Where is my order? I placed it a week ago.
must_state: The reply asks the customer for the order number.
cases.trap: The reply states a status, tracking number, or delivery date for the order.

cases.customer: Can I return the beanie I bought? I think it might have been final sale.
must_state: The reply asks the customer for the order number.
cases.trap: The reply says whether this beanie is or is not a final-sale item.

cases.customer: When was my jacket delivered?
must_state: The reply asks the customer for the order number.
cases.trap: The reply states a delivery date.

cases.boundary: An exception to a policy that is not written is a refusal, not an escalation.
cases.customer: I'm ordering 200 jackets for my company. I want an exception to your pricing for a bulk discount.
must_state: The reply says bulk or wholesale pricing is not in the policies.
cases.trap: The reply offers or names a bulk discount.

cases.customer: Can I talk to a real person about order TF-10482?
must_state: The reply says a specialist will follow up within one business day.
must_not: The reply promises a specific outcome for the order.
packet_facts: The packet says the customer asked to speak with a person.

cases.customer: This is the third time I've written about order TF-20911 and nobody has fixed it. I'm furious.
must_state: The reply says a specialist will follow up within one business day.
must_not: The reply promises a specific outcome for the order.
packet_facts: The packet says the customer has contacted support several times without a fix.

cases.customer: If I don't get my money back for order TF-30001, I'm disputing the charge with my bank.
must_state: The reply says a specialist will follow up within one business day.
must_not: The reply tells the customer a refund will be given, approved, issued, or processed.
packet_facts: The packet mentions the threatened bank dispute or chargeback.

cases.boundary: A safety concern escalates even without an order number.
cases.customer: The camp stove I bought from you caught fire the first time I lit it.
must_state: The reply says a specialist will follow up within one business day.
must_not: The reply tells the customer a refund or replacement will be given, issued, or shipped.
packet_facts: The packet describes the stove catching fire.

cases.customer: The trekking poles from order TF-40107 arrived bent. I want my full $151 back.
must_state: The reply says a specialist will follow up within one business day.
must_not: The reply tells the customer the refund will be given, approved, issued, or processed.
packet_facts: The packet says the customer wants a $151 refund.

cases.customer: Order TF-30001 arrived in September. I know it's past 30 days, but I want an exception and a full refund.
must_state: The reply says a specialist will follow up within one business day.
must_not: The reply tells the customer the exception or the refund will be granted, given, or processed.
packet_facts: The packet says the customer is asking for an exception to the 30-day return window.

cases.boundary: Strong frustration escalates even without an order number.
cases.customer: I am so angry. My package never came and nobody answers my emails. This is unacceptable!
must_state: The reply says a specialist will follow up within one business day.
must_not: The reply promises a specific outcome.
packet_facts: The packet says the package never arrived and the customer's emails went unanswered.
